positions.title: Solutions Engineer (Americas)
positions.description:
As a Solutions Engineer I was highly involved in all pre-sales solution designs and integrations. Some of this included:

- Taking customers from the discovery phase to going live on the platform with a working solution
- Recommending the right products and technical solutions to customers based on their use case
- Building proof-of-concept apps, giving product demos, producing webinars, and writing blog posts
- Regularly reviewing and debugging code for customers
